blockingIssues.description: Droid execution still reuses Codex home/auth/session state via `prepareCodexHome`, so a native Droid provider run can execute with the wrong credentials or fail on machines configured only for Droid.

Agent detail loses Droid provider attribution when the bound runtime is offline or absent from the live runtime list, breaking the required stable provider binding across reloads and liveness changes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify whether strict red-green evidence is mandatory for backend runtime features where the provider path does not exist yet, or enforce capturing a failing targeted test run before implementation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for `droid-provider-runtime-backend-plumbing` noted the worker added tests but only ran them after implementation, despite the skill currently instructing a failing test first.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify or enforce the requirement to add focused automated coverage for UI/provider-attribution work before implementation, especially for offline/history fallback states.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for `droid-runtime-ui-and-agent-binding-surfaces` found a blocking offline-runtime attribution bug and noted that the feature shipped without new tests for the touched surfaces.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that broken local daemon PAT/workspace auth can block required browser confirmation even when the code fix is correct, and spell out the prerequisite checks explicitly.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for `provider-runtime-browser-auth-and-daemon-bootstrap` passed the code changes but recorded that browser confirmation was blocked by invalid daemon auth until library guidance was updated.
